papers.title: High usage of telephone telemedicine among people living with HIV at two federally qualified health centers in Los Angeles.
papers.abstract: Federally qualified health centers (FQHCs) in the United States began the widespread use of telemedicine for HIV care during the COVID-19 pandemic. During a mature phase of the pandemic, we sought to increase the uptake of telemedicine, characterize uptake by modality (telephone versus video), and explore the association of telemedicine use with viral suppression. We implemented a multi-pronged intervention to increase telemedicine (particularly with video) and performed a prospective cohort study to evaluate this intervention. The intervention included: (1) provision of an easy-to-use video visit platform; (2) training on telemedicine best practices; (3) computer-based and support staff reminders to offer a choice of telephone or video telemedicine; (4) a telemedicine navigator; and (5) quarterly quality improvement meetings. We conducted baseline and endline surveys and chart reviews with a cohort of people living with HIV (PLHIV) to measure telemedicine use (including offer, uptake, and visit completion by modality) and changes in viral load. We used mixed effects regression models to evaluate the intervention's association with viral suppression over time (< 40 copies/mL). We enrolled 271 PLHIV between March and November 2022 and implemented the intervention from August 2022-October 2023. Telemedicine visits (telephone and video) in this cohort increased during the intervention period from 13% to 17% of all visits, with this increase predominantly driven by telephone visits. Clinicians' offer of telemedicine visits (based on participant report) varied, with 36% of clients offered both telephone and video visits during the intervention period, 36% offered telephone visits only, and 28% not offered any telemedicine. Visit completion was highest for telephone visits (82%) and lower for video (58%) and in-person (57%) visits. Viral suppression rates were not significantly different from baseline to endline, regardless of telemedicine use: 71.0% to 77.5% in non-users (p = 0.26) and 83.8% to 81.0% (p = 0.19) in users. Our intervention increased the use of telemedicine, predominantly delivered as telephone visits. Additional research is needed on the impact of telemedicine on care engagement over time, on viral suppression over longer follow-up, and on strategies to increase utilization of video visits for PLHIV cared for in FQHC settings.
papers.summary: 本研究針對洛杉磯兩家聯邦合格健康中心的HIV感染者，實施了一項包含提供視訊平台、人員培訓與導航員等的多管齊下干預措施，旨在提升遠端醫療的使用率。結果顯示，干預期間遠端醫療就診比例從13%微增至17%，且增長主要來自電話問診而非視訊；電話問診的完成率最高（82%），但無論是否使用遠端醫療，患者的病毒抑制率在基線與末期之間均無顯著差異。
papers.classification: 遠端醫療與愛滋病照護
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了在HIV社區照護中，儘管透過系統性干預能略微提升遠端醫療的整體使用率，但電話問診仍是患者最易接受且完成度最高的模式，視訊問診的推廣面臨挑戰。這對於公共衛生資源分配具有重要參考價值，未來需進一步探討如何有效整合視訊技術以提升長期照護品質，同時也證實了現有電話遠端醫療在維持病毒抑制效果上的穩定性。

papers.title: Digital health literacy and associated factors among health professionals in Kaski District, Nepal: a cross-sectional study.
papers.abstract: Digital health literacy refers to the ability to find, access, understand and evaluate health related information and apply health information obtained from digital sources. Digital health literacy has become an essential competency for health professionals in modern healthcare settings. With the increasing adoption of several digital softwares by the government of Nepal like District Health Information System, telemedicine, mobile health applications, public assets management System, health professionals are expected to effectively use digital platforms to deliver evidence-based care and communicate with patients and other providers. This study aims to assess the digital health literacy and its associated factors among health professionals in Kaski district, Nepal. A quantitative cross-sectional analytical study was done among 318 health professionals working in public and private health facilities of Kaski district. Data were collected through self-administered questionnaires utilizing e-HEALS tools. Maintaining the health research ethics, multistage sampling technique was used to obtain the study participants. Data were analyzed in SPSS software using descriptive and inferential statistics including chi-square test and binary logistic regression. About 46.2% of the participants had a low level of digital health literacy. Most of the health professionals used digital health technology to gain information about diseases and fewer used it for patient follow-up. Although the majority of participants (73.8%) agreed that digital health technology has enhanced healthcare delivery, many participants expressed low confidence in making health related decisions using online information and had difficulty in understanding the limitations of online health resources. Additionally, factors such as; being a doctor (AOR = 5.176; 95% CI: 1.274-21.031), working in the Pharmacy department (AOR = 3.995; 95% CI: 1.129-14.141) and having a positive attitude towards use of digital technology (AOR = 0.544; 95% CI: 0.326-0.909) were identified as contributors to high digital health literacy. Notable, few participants had received training on digital health technology. Hence, training, practical workshops and simulation exercises should be organized to build confidence among health workers in health-related decision making using online information.
papers.summary: 本研究針對尼泊爾卡斯基區318名醫療衛生人員進行橫斷面分析，以e-HEALS工具評估其數位健康素養。結果顯示，約46.2%的受訪者具備較低水平的數位健康素養，多數人雖認同數位技術能提升醫療服務品質，但主要用於查詢疾病資訊，較少用於患者追蹤，且對於利用線上資訊進行醫療決策缺乏信心，難以辨識線上資源的侷限性。研究發現，身為醫師、任職於藥劑部門以及對數位技術抱持積極態度是具備高數位健康素養的顯著相關因素。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了在醫療數位化轉型過程中，基層醫療人員在數位健康素養上的實質缺口，凸顯出僅僅引入數位系統不足以發揮應有效益。研究結果強調，針對醫療人員提供專門的數位健康技術培訓、實務工作坊與模擬演練至關重要，這不僅能提升其運用線上資源進行臨床決策的信心，更是確保基層醫療機構能夠有效落實循證醫療與優化病患照護品質的關鍵策略。

papers.title: Development and validation of the Primary Care Organizations Organizational Health Literacy Scales (PCO-OHL Scales): a dual perspective from clients and healthcare providers.
papers.abstract: Primary care organizations (PCOs) are crucial in promoting organizational health literacy (OHL), which helps individuals access, understand, and use health information. However, research on OHL in primary care is limited and often reflects a single perspective. This study aimed to develop the Primary Care Organizations Organizational Health Literacy Scales (PCO-OHL Scales) from the dual perspectives of clients and healthcare providers. The study consisted of two phases. In Phase I, a framework was adapted, and items were developed via literature review, interviews, and field observations. After expert review and two Delphi rounds, an 18-item Parent Version was created and then adapted into parallel client and healthcare provider versions. Phase II assessed content validity via expert ratings and tested reliability (Cronbach' s α and test-retest) with 348 clients and 326 healthcare providers from 11 PCOs. The final scales included six dimensions: Leadership and Management, Workforce, Access and Navigation, Communication, Consumer Involvement, and External Cooperation. Content validity (S-CVI/Ave) was 0.944 (client) and 0.956 (healthcare provider). Cronbach' s α was 0.926 and 0.889, and ICCs were 0.772 and 0.895, respectively. Survey data showed client and healthcare provider scores of 59.97 ± 10.01 and 65.81 ± 6.77. Among 18 item pairs, 5 received high ratings from both groups, 7 received relatively lower ratings from both groups, and 6 showed differences in ratings between clients and healthcare providers. The PCO-OHL Scales are reliable, valid tools that capture both client and provider views. By incorporating dual perspectives, the scales enable a more comprehensive assessment of organizational practices and user experiences in primary care.
papers.summary: 本研究開發並驗證了「初級照護組織組織健康素養量表」（PCO-OHL Scales），這是首個同時涵蓋客戶與醫療保健提供者雙重視角的評估工具。該量表透過文獻回顧、訪談、專家審查及德菲爾法構建，涵蓋領導與管理、人力資源、獲取與導航、溝通、消費者參與及外部合作六個維度，共18個項目。研究邀請348名客戶與326名提供者進行測試，結果顯示量表具備良好的內容效度與信度，且揭示了雙方在部分組織健康素養實踐上存在評價差異。
papers.significance: 此量表的問世填補了初級照護領域缺乏雙視角組織健康素養評估工具的空白。透過同時納入服務使用者與提供者的反饋，該工具能協助醫療機構更全面地檢視健康資訊的傳遞與獲取障礙，從而制定更具針對性的改善策略，最終提升基層醫療的服務品質與民眾的健康素養水平。

papers.title: Regional cancer care leads´ and patient representatives´ perspectives on national governance and organisation of palliative cancer care.
papers.abstract: Ensuring that national governance and healthcare systems include the organization and provision of palliative care in all care settings for all patients in need is a global imperative. In cancer care, early palliative care can improve quality of life for patients and families and receiving specialised palliative care increases opportunities for care and death in the preferred place, which for a majority is the own home. In Sweden, national general health policy only vaguely addresses palliative care, leading to the introduction of specific guidelines in 2013. These coexist with national disease-specific guidelines for cancer care that are ambiguous in their conceptualisation and inclusion of palliative care. From a governance and organisation perspective, place of death serves as a key indicator of palliative care infrastructure and organisation. Since policy initiation in 2013, hospital has remained the predominant place of death in Sweden. Further, regional disparities persist and are influenced by factors such as age, sex, and access to specialised services, pointing to inequities and unsatisfactory governance and organisation of palliative care. The aim of this study was to explore the perspectives of cancer care leads and patient representatives on national governance and organisation of palliative cancer care. Interpretive description methodology was used to generate and inductively analyse data from group discussions and individual interviews with 36 cancer- and palliative care leads, and patient representatives from the six Swedish regional cancer centres. The analysis revealed patterns of interdependent conditions that, from the perspectives of cancer care leads and patient representatives shape the governance and organisation of palliative cancer care and seemingly trigger ambiguity regarding responsibilities and inequalities in service provision: Multilevel knowledge gaps about palliative care; Challenges and complexities of providing palliative care in a fragmented healthcare system; and Policy impact and ownership problems. The study revealed significant challenges in national palliative cancer care governance, primarily due to a multilevel knowledge gap about palliative care, a fragmented healthcare system, and non-directive national policies. Integration of mandatory national minimum requirements for palliative care in national policy, and clearer standards for palliative care resource allocation are needed. Comprehensive strategies and coordinated efforts that can be uniformly implemented across regions, and establishing national collaborative spaces for regional stakeholders are essential to ensure equitable and timely access to palliative care for all patients with advanced cancer.
papers.summary: 本研究探討瑞典地區癌症護理負責人與患者代表對國家緩和癌症護理治理與組織的看法。研究發現，儘管瑞典於2013年引入特定指引，但由於存在多層級的緩和醫療知識空白、醫療體系高度碎片化，以及國家政策缺乏強制力與所有權歸屬不明等相互依存的條件，導致責任模糊與服務供應不平等。自政策實施以來，醫院仍是瑞典最主要的死亡地點，且地區差異持續存在，顯示當前治理與組織架構仍不盡理想。
papers.significance: 此研究突顯了國家級緩和醫療治理面臨的結構性挑戰，為政策制定者提供了關鍵的改革依據。研究強烈呼籲在國家政策中納入強制性的緩和醫療最低標準、建立更明確的資源分配準則，並打造全國性的協作空間。這不僅有助於消除現有的地區與人口照護不平等，更是確保所有晚期癌症患者能夠公平、及時獲得高品質緩和護理的必要條件。

papers.title: Using normalization process theory to evaluate the implementation of a hybrid psychosocial prevention intervention in mental health care - a qualitative interview study.
papers.abstract: The increase in mental health disorders underscores the importance of preventive interventions and strategies. The approach of hybrid interventions integrating analog and common therapeutic approaches with digital health applications offers promising solutions but faces challenges in routine implementation. This study examines the implementation of the new hybrid intervention 'RV Fit Mental Health' within the German health care system, using Normalization Process Theory (NPT) as the guiding theoretical framework. A qualitative study was conducted with nine experts involved in the development and implementation of the intervention, including professionals from the therapeutic and administrative domains of the implementation. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews and analyzed using qualitative content analysis, following the NPT framework and the NPT coding manual. The findings demonstrate that while the shift towards preventive care within the intervention required substantial organizational and normative adaptations, the intervention was largely perceived as a valuable and integrative addition in established care. Facilitating factors included stakeholder collaboration, a shared understanding of and goals for preventive care, and flexible, open organizational structures. Barriers and challenges were mainly linked to time and resource constraints, technical integration of the digital component, and the redefinition of professional roles. The implementation of the intervention reshaped therapeutic routines, fostered interdisciplinary collaboration, and was increasingly normalized within the specific conditions of a model project, both within clinical and administrative workflows and across organizational boundaries. The implementation of the hybrid intervention RV Fit Mental Health was largely successful. The evaluation of the implementation of (hybrid) interventions benefits from a theory-driven approach. NPT provided valuable insights into how such interventions are embedded in existing systems and structures and how preventive and hybrid approaches can be sustainably integrated. The results offer both theoretical and practical implications for the design, implementation, and evaluation of similar interventions in diverse healthcare settings. DRKS-ID: DRKS00033080 (Date of registration: 07 December 2023).
papers.summary: 本研究運用常態化過程理論（NPT），透過質性訪談評估德國醫療體系中混合式心理預防干預方案「RV Fit Mental Health」的實施過程。研究指出，儘管向預防性護理的轉變需要顯著的組織與規範調整，但該方案仍被視為現有醫療照護中有價值的整合。利益相關者的協作、共同目標及靈活的組織結構是主要促進因素，而時間與資源限制、數位組件的技術整合困難及專業角色的重新定義則是主要障礙。最終，該干預措施成功重塑了治療常規並促進了跨領域合作，在特定模型項目條件下實現了常態化。
papers.significance: 此研究證實了理論驅動方法（如NPT）在評估混合式醫療干預措施實施上的高價值，為理解數位與實體結合的干預方案如何嵌入現有醫療體系提供了深刻見解。其成果不僅為該方案的永續整合奠定基礎，更為不同醫療環境中設計、實施與評估類似的預防性與混合式照護方案提供了重要的理論與實踐指引，有助於推動心理健康預防服務的常態化與跨學科發展。

papers.title: The political polarization of health outcomes in the USA.
papers.abstract: Public health disparities provide an important lens for understanding social and political change in the USA. Using individual-level medical data and death records, this study shows that conservative Americans experienced worsening health and higher mortality than liberals during the 2010s. Here we find evidence consistent with two potential mechanisms. First, demographic realignment within political coalitions brought less healthy individuals into the conservative camp. Yet by the 2020s, demographic change, public policy and COVID-19 do not fully account for the widening gap in mortality rates. Public opinion data are consistent with a second mechanism: declining trust in medical professionals among right-leaning individuals, including lower willingness to seek care, follow clinical advice or believe in medication effectiveness, even for issues unrelated to COVID-19. These patterns suggest that growing ideological divides in health behaviours are leaving conservative Americans increasingly vulnerable to preventable health risks.
papers.summary: 本研究利用個人醫療數據與死亡記錄，分析2010年代美國政治立場與健康結果的關係。研究發現，保守派美國人的健康狀況惡化且死亡率高於自由派。此現象部分源於政治聯盟的人口結構重組，但到了2020年代，人口、政策與COVID-19等因素已無法完全解釋擴大的死亡率差距。另一關鍵機制在於右傾個體對醫療專業人員的信任度下降，表現為就醫意願降低、不遵從臨床建議及對藥物療效的懷疑，且此不信任趨勢已延伸至非COVID-19的健康議題。
papers.significance: 該研究揭示了意識形態分歧如何實質性地轉化為公共健康風險，表明政治極化已超越傳統政策範疇，直接威脅特定群體的生命健康。這不僅為理解美國社會分化提供了全新的健康視角，也凸顯了重建醫療信任與跨黨派公共衛生溝通在應對未來可預防疾病風險中的迫切性。
